page_title: MNU 0-3 LIV | Manchester Utd v Liverpool 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The ball possession is 51:49.
90+2' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.

90+2' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' What a chance that is! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
89' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

89' Mohamed Salah finds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he spanks the shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

87' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 4:3.
86' Here is a change. Joshua Zirkzee is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
85' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
83' Here comes a substitution. Andrew Robertson is given a rest as he is replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool).

81' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
80' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

80' Good clearance! Toby Collyer (Manchester United) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
78' A lofted pass into the box is met by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
76' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Conor Bradley (Liverpool) replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold.
76' Here's the change. Diogo Jota leaves the pitch and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
73' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).

73' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) sends in a close-range first-time shot. It's a poor effort which sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
73' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner kick, but Alisson reads it well and stops the effort.
72' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
70' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) wasted a big chance to finish after the resulting free kick! He latched on to a well-placed cross deep inside the box and produced a fine header towards the net!
70' It seemed like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
69' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Alejandro Garnacho will be replaced by Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harry Maguire (Manchester United) will replace Matthijs de Ligt.
69' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick.

67' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Dominik Szoboszlai. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
66' It's time for a substitution. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) comes on in place of Luis Diaz.
65' The game has begun to heat up. Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

64' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alisson shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
61' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
60' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

58' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.

58' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.

56' 0 - 3 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) neatly controls a decent pass from Dominik Szoboszlai. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 0:3.
55' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
55' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

52' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
50' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
47' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Half-time substitution. Erik ten Hag decided to make a change. Casemiro is replaced by Toby Collyer (Manchester United).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
45+3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45+1' What was Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
42' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) was set free in the area by Mohamed Salah and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
40' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

40' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alisson was alert and the score remained the same.
38' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
35' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Mohamed Salah sends a long raking pass onto the head of Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
33' A clumsy foul by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
32' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the right post.
31' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes it short.
31' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
30' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
29' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
25' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
23' Anthony Taylor shows the yellow card to Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) for a heavy challenge.
21' The game is interrupted now, Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
15' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Manchester Utd have a corner.
13' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
12' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' The goal by Liverpool is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
8' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
7' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) gets to the ball after a big mistake by the defending player and scores with a precise shot into the right side of the goal.

5' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

3' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
2' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' The first half has started.
